# Changelog

## 0.1.0

First public release of the environment. Runtime closure
`f347b0c8eee94ba36cd69818603178eb7e4c10e5afc4e21cf8eb8ec6308a4963`
(18 modules plus bootstrap, byte-identical to the sealed
`hardened-v6-aecadda` epoch), plus the replay-only amended runtime
`10967be0011b7c7808a47a108e74b1076f5141b10a5d5a7d39fa4d4087e8179b`
(`epochs/amended-v5/`, epoch `24a5713`). Adds the `headgasket` launcher
(serve, replay, verify, validate, prepare, family, pins, tools), the V1-V5
configurations (byte-identical to the configurations in the published run
records, and regenerated byte for byte by `prepare`), the test suite and the
documentation. See `docs/PROVENANCE.md` for what differs from the sealed epoch
and why.
